message: feat(unified): U05 单活动GPU、异步完成与批次失败保留
rulings: Original Task5 BASE remains 72b0020; checkpoint 2e9631 preserves the core implementation. Kernel wrappers/header/build-check helper are scoped additions required for Linux compile/link, not model behavior changes.

Linux ioctl/worker/poll routing is startup-only and inactive unless U06 binds one exact provider. Legacy 176-byte dispatch and profile4 fastwait branches are unchanged. The pre-binding module is not a U23 release/image.

Host boundary tests cover timeout/signal, copy faults, repeated readiness and 100 real pthread close/worker races. They do not execute actual kernel device epoll or DMA. Real board/IRQ/performance remain untested.

WAIT length is 0..60000 milliseconds; READ and ACK are separate exclusive flags. Completion read and submit return-copy faults never retire or reexecute. Unknown stop/close retains pinned objects and quarantine.

Module build parent config/symbols unchanged; AArch64 ELF and adapter symbols verified, GPU raw cycles=null. All 105 original raw log/receipt members were copied and verified on A; B originals retained.

U06 must implement bootstrap CAPS without requiring an unknown epoch, typed buffer/catalog operations, matching provider admission, private PS mapping and controlled ARGS adaptation; no weakening of U05 role checks.
